usedFor: Liliphant handles customer conversations and meetings; HubSpot is where you record the outcome. A “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” in Liliphant can run “Add Notes to Contact” so the summary lands on the right person.

bestTemplate.name: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” in Liliphant, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The summary is the content worth keeping, and this action saves it as a note on the contact, found by ID or email, with a date and body.

watchOut: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” is polling, so notes arrive after the next check. “Update Company” needs a company ID, and “Create Contact” needs an email.
